jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for a PLASTERER.

As an all-round plasterer, you will be responsible for various plastering and finishing works. You will work on both interior and exterior projects and ensure a neat and high-quality finish every time.

Your responsibilities as a PLASTERER:

  • Carrying out plastering works;
  • Preparing surfaces;
  • Applying and finishing interior and exterior plaster;
  • Repairing and touching up existing plasterwork;
  • Finishing corners, edges and connections;
  • Working with spray cork;
  • Working with different materials and techniques;
  • Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish;
  • Working on different construction sites and projects.
This is you as a PLASTERER:

  • You have experience as a plasterer or renovation worker;
  • You can work independently, but also work well as part of a team;
  • You have an eye for detail and deliver a neat finish;
  • You are physically fit;
  • You speak Dutch or fluent Englisch;
  • You have a valid category B driving licence.

As an ELECTROMECHANIC – DAY SHIFT in WEST FLANDERS, you will work closely with our clients to ensure the optimal performance and efficiency of their machinery and contribute to their operational success.

Your responsibilities as an ELECTROMECHANIC in WEST FLANDERS:

  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical and electrical faults, including under time pressure;
  • Carry out preventive maintenance according to the maintenance schedule;
  • Actively contribute ideas for improvements related to machinery, safety, quality and efficiency;
  • Participate in optimization and continuous improvement projects;
  • Contribute to a smooth and efficient production environment;
  • Work in a refrigerated production environment (4–6°C) that is cleaned industrially on a daily basis. Safety, cleanliness and quality are key priorities.
AS AN ELECTROMECHANIC IN WEST FLANDERS, YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF IN THE FOLLOWING:
  • You have a degree in electromechanics or relevant experience as a maintenance or breakdown technician, with a strong focus on electrical systems;
  • You have an analytical mindset and can quickly identify and resolve technical faults efficiently;
  • You can work independently and take responsibility in a mature and professional manner;
  • You have a good command of Dutch or English;
  • You are motivated to grow and develop within a company that is continuously expanding.

Apply now for this vacancy or send your CV to westkust@absolutejobs.be.

For our client located in BRUGES, we are looking for a ROOFER.

Do you enjoy working at heights and do you have experience as a roofer, mainly working on pitched roofs? Then we are looking for you!

As a ROOFER in the Bruges region, your day will look like this:

  • Mainly covering pitched roofs, but occasionally also flat roofs;
  • Renovating existing roofs (no new-build projects);
  • Installing roofing materials;
  • Assessing the structural characteristics of existing roofs;
  • Installing and sealing carpentry elements in the roof;
  • Bonding and installing EPDM.
As a ROOFER in BRUGES, you have the following qualities:

  • You have solid work experience as a roofer, with experience working on pitched roofs;
  • You have a category B driving licence;
  • The starting location is Bruges, Blauwe-Toren area;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You are not afraid of heights.

For our client, a well-known company in the BRUGES region, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER.

Do you enjoy variety in your job and do you like renovation work? Then you are the person we are looking for!

As a RENOVATION WORKER in the BRUGES region, your day will look like this:

  • Together with your colleagues, you will carry out demolition and repair work as part of renovation projects;
  • Carrying out general renovation works on houses and buildings;
  • Demolition works and preparing the construction site;
  • Bricklaying, plastering and small concrete works;
  • Installing and repairing floors and walls;
  • Installing insulation and drywall/plasterboard;
  • Ensuring that the entire renovation project is completed to a high standard;
  • Ensuring that structural works and stability requirements are properly taken into account.
As a RENOVATION WORKER in BRUGES, you have the following qualities:

  • You have solid work experience as a renovation worker and are fully familiar with flooring, carpentry, bricklaying, etc.;
  • You have a category B driving licence;
  • The starting location is Bruges (Blauwe-Toren), at the company’s warehouse;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You are not afraid of heights.

For our client, a well-known company in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER.

Do you enjoy variety in your job and do you like renovation work? Then you are the person we are looking for!

As a RENOVATION WORKER in the VEURNE region, your day will look like this:

  • Together with your colleagues, you will carry out demolition and repair work as part of renovation projects;
  • Carrying out general renovation works on houses and buildings;
  • Demolition works and preparing the construction site;
  • Bricklaying, plastering and small concrete works;
  • Installing and repairing floors and walls;

  • Ensuring that the entire renovation project is completed to a high standard;
  • Ensuring that structural works and stability requirements are properly taken into account.
As a RENOVATION WORKER in VEURNE, you have the following qualities:

  • You have solid work experience as a renovation worker and are fully familiar with flooring, carpentry, bricklaying, etc.;
  • You have a category B driving licence;
  • The starting location is Bruges (Blauwe-Toren), at the company’s warehouse;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You are not afraid of heights.

As a logistical inventory specialist, you strengthen the team of order pickers at Kuehne+Nagel in Geel working in 2 shifts for €16,3753/hour and meal vouchers.

You fulfill a versatile key position as a logistical inventory specialist, combining the physical order picking of famous toy products with the administrative follow-up of inventory and quality controls. Thanks to your sharp eye and accurate way of working, your contribution as a logistical inventory specialist guarantees a flawless logistical process.

Ready to take the next step as an order picker? Aply via talentcenter1@randstad.be or 011 54 92 85!

VG 458/BUOSAP

Who are we looking for?

• At least 6 months of demonstrable experience within the logistics sector.
• Practical experience with a hand scanner and administrative follow-up.
• Good command of either the Dutch or English language.
• Willingness to work in a 2-shift system.
• Possession of your own transport to reach the location in Geel.
Key responsibilities

• Physically collecting toy goods and orders using a hand scanner.
• Performing thorough quality checks on picked orders from colleague order pickers.
• Monitoring stock levels and supporting warehouse administration.
• Spotting and correcting inventory discrepancies at an early stage.

Join Kuehne+Nagel in Geel as an experienced order picker and earn €16,3753/hour plus €8 meal vouchers working in a 2-shift system!

In this varied role, you will combine active order picking with quality control and warehouse administration. You will ensure top quality for renowned brands and make sure every shipment is in perfect condition.

Ready to take the next step in your logistics career? Send your CV to talentcenter1@randstad.be or call us directly at 011 54 92 85!

VG 458/BUOSA

What are we looking for in a candidate?

• Minimum of 6 months to 1 year of experience in a warehouse setting or order picking.
• Proven experience working with a handheld scanner is required.
• Good command of either Dutch or English.
• Willing to work in a 2-shift rotation on a long-term basis.
• Must have your own transport to commute to the site in Geel.
Your main duties as an order picker:

• Order picking goods in the warehouse using a handheld scanner.
• Conducting accurate quality control checks on picked orders.
• Checking and monitoring physical inventory and stock discrepancies.
• Handling the required warehouse administration within the system.
• Reporting deviations and safeguarding overall quality standards.

For our client in the ICHTEGEM region, we are looking for a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER.

Our client is a family-owned company specialized in bulk transport, concrete transport, tipper truck transport and traction transport.

As a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER in ICHTEGEM, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Delivering soil and waste materials from earthworks using a tipper truck;
  • Transporting and delivering materials in accordance with safety regulations and applicable instructions;
  • Cleaning the truck;
  • Communicating with customers in a friendly and professional manner;
  • Unloading the truck at construction sites and driving back to reload.
As a CE DRIVER in NIEUWPOORT, you can identify with the following:

  • Experience as a CE DRIVER;
  • You are in possession of a CE driving licence, a valid Code 95 and a driver card;
  • You speak Dutch OR English OR French.

Are you an experienced asphalt worker who enjoys rolling up your sleeves?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced asphalt worker to join our asphalt crew.

What does your job involve?

  • You assist the asphalt crew with the preparation, laying and finishing of hot-mix asphalt;
  • You help ensure the correct distribution and finishing of the asphalt;
  • You are responsible for touching up and finishing asphalt around joints and connections;
  • You help create a smooth and high-quality road surface;
  • You work closely with machine operators, roller operators, drivers and other colleagues on site;
  • You work with modern machinery, techniques and tools;
  • You depart daily from Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience in asphalt works, preferably as an asphalt worker;
  • You have knowledge of the different steps involved in laying and finishing hot-mix asphalt;
  • You are physically fit and enjoy active, hands-on work;
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions;
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English;
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

Are you an experienced roller operator with a passion for asphalt works?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced roller operator for our asphalt works.

What does your job involve?

  • You independently operate the road roller during asphalt works.
  • You ensure the correct and even compaction of the asphalt according to the required quality standards.
  • You take into account the temperature and composition of the asphalt and adapt your working method accordingly.
  • You work closely with machine operators, drivers and other colleagues in the asphalt crew.
  • You help monitor the quality of the road surface and ensure that the works are carried out accurately.
  • You work with modern machines, techniques and tools.
  • You carry out daily checks and help ensure the proper maintenance of the machine.
  • You depart daily from the depot in Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience as a road roller operator, preferably in asphalt or road construction.
  • You have a good understanding of asphalt compaction and understand the importance of using the correct rolling technique.
  • You have good technical insight and can work confidently with modern machinery.
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions.
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English.
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

For the strengthening of our team, we are looking for a truck driver with a Category C driving licence to operate our emulsion truck.

You will depart from our depot in Oostende and drive to various construction sites throughout West Flanders. In addition to the transport, you will also be responsible for the correct application and processing of the emulsion on site, meaning you will be active both behind the wheel and on the construction site.

Your responsibilities:

  • You transport emulsion from our depot in Oostende to various construction sites throughout West Flanders;
  • You are responsible for the correct and safe loading and unloading of emulsion;
  • You operate the emulsion truck's equipment and ensure the correct application of the emulsion;
  • You work both with machinery and manually during the processing of emulsion on site.



What do we expect from you?

  • You have a valid Category C driving licence.
  • Code 95 is NOT required.
  • You have good technical insight and are willing to learn how the emulsion truck operates and how emulsion is processed on site.
  • You speak and understand sufficient Dutch or English to communicate safely and smoothly with your colleagues.

Would you like to help build high-quality roads throughout West Flanders? Then we would love to hear from you!

jobs.occupation: Sales operations representative EN/DE | Brecht | Permanent Contract
jobs.description:
Position: Sales Operations Representative / Order Administrator 

Location: Brecht 

As a Sales Operations Representative / Order Processor, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth order processing and customer satisfaction. You will follow up on orders, report and resolve incidents, and communicate effectively with both customers and internal departments. You will coordinate shipments with factories and be an integral part of the team based in Brecht, handling orders for the US market. 

Primary Duties & Responsibilities: 

 
• Review incoming customer orders for items, pricing, and export license requirements. 
 
• Process sales orders in the ERP system (SAP) using the ESKER tool. 
 
• Process purchase orders at manufacturing plants, if required. 
 
• Follow up on sales orders with manufacturing plants and warehouses to ensure timely delivery. 
 
• Communicate with customers regarding their orders; resolve delivery issues, respond to inquiries, and provide necessary delivery documentation. 
 
• Request export documentation from customers as needed. 
 
• Invoice customers after delivery and monitor customer balances prior to shipment. 
 
• Maintain and closely monitor order backlog. 
 
• Record orders and customer information in internal systems and files. 
 
• Serve as a backup for other Sales Operations Specialists when needed. 

 
• A college Diploma or equivalent required, AS or higher in business preferred. 
 
• A first experience in Customer service - Order Processing is required. 
 
• A very good and professional command of English is required. In addition, a good command of German is required. 
 
• Ability to communicate effectively: strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 
• Flexible, easy-going and able to adapt to a fast-paced and sometimes changing environment. 
 
• Good time management skills with the ability to prioritize, follow-through, and complete tasks on time. 
 
• Focused and versatile team player that is comfortable under pressure. 
 
• Detail oriented with high level of accuracy. 
 
• Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills. 
 
• Self-motivated and good level of focus/concentration. 
 
• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. 
 
• Strong computer skills and experience with SAP. 
 
• You have your own transportation and a valid driving license (difficult to reach by public transport).

ABOUT ACE
 

ACE, founded in 1977, is an international engineering group, with more than 200 people and with operations in Belgium, the Netherlands, Poland and Portugal. We combine engineering, consultancy, (prototype) machine building and product development, working with customers across a range of industrial sectors.
 

Our different activities and entities require a finance organisation that works effectively across borders, with consistent processes, reporting and controls. Further harmonising Finance across the group is therefore an important step in the continued development of ACE.
 

THE ROLE
 

As Head of Finance, you will have overall financial responsibility for ACE in Belgium, the Netherlands, Poland and Portugal. You will define the financial processes, reporting principles and controls across the group and further align financial operations across the different countries.
 

You will shape the financial architecture of the group on reporting, accounting, tax, budgeting, cashflow management and business performance analysis.
 

You will take a hands-on approach, further embed the accounting processes within the ERP system and deliver timely and reliable financial visibility of the business to the Board and management of the group.
 

As a member of the Management Team, you will bring financial insight to operational and strategic decision-making in support of the growth of the group.
 

 
 

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
 

- Act as a strategic financial partner, providing clear insight on performance, growth initiatives
 

and value creation across the different countries and entities.
 

- Optimise working capital and cash discipline (invoicing, billing, cash conversion,
 

WIP/inventory).
 

- Enhance visibility into profitability by customer, project, service line, country and legal
 

entity.
 

- Lead, mentor and develop the finance teams, creating a high-performance culture focused
 

on accountability and continuous improvement.
 

- Strengthen and safeguard compliance, governance and risk management across the group.
 

You will directly manage the finance teams in Lummen (BE), Bruges (BE), Eindhoven (NL) and
 

Poznan (PL) and work directly with the branch manager in Porto (PT). You will report directly to the member of the Board at group level.
 

 
 

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
 

- At least 10 years of relevant experience in finance, including experience with broad financial
 

responsibility.
 

- Experience working across multiple legal entities. International experience is an advantage.
 

- Broad financial expertise covering accounting, controlling, consolidation, budgeting,
 

forecasting and cash flow.
 

- Experience leading and developing finance professionals.
 

- Strong analytical skills combined with a hands-on approach and the willingness to take on
 

operational financial matters yourself.
 

- Experience structuring and improving financial processes in a multi-entity environment.
 

- Experience in an industrial, engineering or project-driven environment is preferred.
 

- Experience with ERP systems; knowledge of AFAS is an advantage.
 

- Full professional proficiency in Dutch and English.
 

 
 

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE INTERESTING?
 

You will take on a broad financial mandate across four countries, with direct involvement in the management and decision-making of the group. The role gives you the opportunity to further shape the finance organisation, bring greater consistency across the different entities and have a visible impact on the further development of the group.
 

Interested? We look forward to your application!

For our client, we are looking for a motivated INDUSTRIAL CLEANER.
 

 
• Assisting with emptying the tunnels (partially mechanical/partially manual)
 
• Cleaning large tunnels using a high-pressure cleaner
 
• Assisting with filling the tunnels
 
• Thinking along when adding quantities of spawn
 
• Cleaning transport belts at height (no fear of heights!) 

What do we expect from you as an industrial cleaner?
 

 
• You have some initial experience as an industrial cleaner
 
• You are in good physical health and not afraid to work in a dirty environment
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system (5-13 & 13-21)
 
• You actively contribute to the cleaning process
 
• You are a team player but can also work independently
 
• You speak Dutch, French or English

Do you also love fries and are looking for a new challenge? Our client is a leading player in the production and development of potato-based delicacies. Due to further growth of the Wielsbeke site, we are looking for a Malfunction Technician curative maintenance in night shift As a technician, you are the key to quickly and efficiently solving technical malfunctions on our fully automated machinery. Your goal? Ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
 
 
• Be an example in adhering to prescribed guidelines and procedures for a safe, environmentally conscious, and orderly working environment. 
 
• Dive deep into mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems to diagnose and resolve faults. 
 
• Perform repairs and replace defective parts to keep our machines in top condition. 
 
• Work closely with our operations teams and your technical colleagues to minimise breakdowns and maximise efficiency. 
 
• Keep fault reports in our maintenance software (Ultimo) to gain insight and keep improving. 
 
• Share your expertise and advise on possible improvements to prevent repeat breakdowns. 
 
• You will mentor new employees to help them grow in their roles 
 
• You will work in our Maintenance department, reporting to your Technical Team Leader. 

 
 
• You have a technical education or equivalent experience 
 
• You have several years of experience as a technician and a passion for technology 
 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems 
 
• You have a proactive attitude 
 
• You have logical insight and good problem-solving skills, allowing you to work independently 
 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and joint success 
 
• You speak Dutch or French or English and are willing to understand other language colleagues 
 
• You are willing to work in the night shift

jobs.occupation: Inside sales | German market | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
As an Inside Sales Representative, you will take ownership of the German market, developing new business opportunities and building long-term customer relationships. You will join a dynamic, international family-owned company in the food industry, where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a well-established international company operating within the food sector. With a family-business mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and strong growth ambitions, they offer a fast-paced environment where initiative and results are highly valued.

Omschrijving

•  Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities within the German market.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals.
• Conduct commercial negotiations and follow up on sales opportunities.
• Expand the customer portfolio and strengthen market presence.
• Analyze sales performance and market trends.
• Report on sales activities and contribute to the overall sales strategy.
 

•  Fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch or additional languages is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development, or a commercial role.
• Strong commercial acumen and a results-oriented mindset.
• A true go-getter with the drive to open new doors and create opportunities.
• Confident communicator with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Affinity with the food industry is an advantage.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.
